Class AutoPaymentsCreateBills

public without sharing class AutoPaymentsCreateBills
implements Schedulable

Schedulable class that creates bills for accounts with automatic payments. Queries accounts configured for auto-payment, calculates the sales period based on frequency and exclusion settings, then chains Queueable jobs to invoke the bill creation flow for each qualifying account.

Queueable job that processes a stack of AccountPaymentCalculation records one at a time.
public void
execute(SchedulableContext context)
Executes the scheduled job by delegating to runFlow().
public static void
runFlow()
Queries all accounts with automatic payments via AccountSelector.getAutoPaymentAccounts(), filters by today's day-of-week against AutomaticPaymentFrequency__c, calculates the sales period using AutomaticPaymentDaysExcluded__c and prior bill dates, then enqueues CreateBill jobs for each qualifying account.
